test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘C / D’ means ‘C is the sister of D’.

‘C < D’ means ‘C is the husband of D’.

‘C @ D’ means ‘C is the father of D’.

‘C + D’ means ‘C is the son of D’.

If P @ Q + R / S < T, how is T related to Q?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5df405191322742ae9fa10bc50efdb0cb5c7ddcf0421e61bb8812f46b9813d6.png] 

According to the given information, the family tree can be drawn:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6678f6018c7701297346db9222a60937cfacc1608ce800781839bf58c95e47d3.png] 

Here, we can see that T is the mother’s brother’s wife of Q

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Mother’s brother’s wife"**.
